column4: MySQL-only by subject: the test builds a MySQL scratch database to assert the properties the structural differential cannot see -- the trigger, both seed rows and their order, per-column collation, the descending index and auto_increment -- so there is no PostgreSQL or SQL Server arm to run. ONE skip, on the PARENT name, because newMySQLScratchDB is called at the top of the test before any t.Run: the whole test skips and its subtests never register, which is the opposite shape from the sibling catalogdiff line that grants three children. Measured by NAME, not by delta, with CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL unset: go test ./migration/ -run TestTheMySQLBaselineKeepsWhatCatalogdiffCannotSee -count=1 -json reports exactly this one name and no failures. This job supplies PostgreSQL only; Tier 1 Gate and multi-db-ci.yml set CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and run it for real. cleat#2433, cleat#2448.
